title: Tiny, cute paintbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- paintbrush handle -->
  <rect x='42' y='20' width='16' height='45' rx='5' fill='#e8b84b'/>
  <rect x='42' y='20' width='16' height='45' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#f5d78a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- handle highlight -->
  <rect x='45' y='24' width='4' height='35' rx='2' fill='#f7e29a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- ferrule (metal band) -->
  <rect x='40' y='62' width='20' height='12' rx='2' fill='#c0c8d4'/>
  <rect x='40' y='62' width='20' height='4' rx='1' fill='#e0e6f0'/>
  <rect x='40' y='70' width='20' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a0a8b8'/>
  <!-- bristles -->
  <path d='M41 74 L39 92 Q50 98 61 92 L59 74 Z' fill='#e05a7a'/>
  <!-- bristle tip lighter shade -->
  <path d='M39 92 Q50 98 61 92 L60 86 Q50 90 40 86 Z' fill='#ff8fa8'/>
  <!-- bristle detail lines -->
  <line x1='45' y1='76' x2='44' y2='90' stroke='#c04060' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='76' x2='50' y2='93' stroke='#c04060' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='76' x2='56' y2='90' stroke='#c04060' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- paint dab on tip -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='94' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#4ecdc4'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='93' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#7ff0e8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- cute eyes on ferrule -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='67' r='2.2' fill='#2a2545'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='67' r='2.2' fill='#2a2545'/>
  <circle cx='46.8' cy='66.4' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54.8' cy='66.4' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tiny smile -->
  <path d='M47 70 Q50 72.5 53 70' stroke='#2a2545' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
